The cost of renewable power has dropped precipitously, while its scale has grown
dramatically. Over the past seven years, wind and solar energy costs have decreased
by 66% and 85%, respectively.20 In 2015, wind and solar energy became the world’s
largest source of newly installed power capacity,21 and in 2016, almost two-thirds of
net new power capacity globally came from renewable energy.22 Renewables have
become a mainstream source of affordable electricity for millions of people.
Increasing the share of renewables on the grid would bring many positive impacts.
For example, doubling renewables by 2030 is expected to increase global gross

employ more than 24 million people in the renewable energy sector.23 At Google, we’ll
